remarks: Discover the epitome of coastal elegance with this stunning 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo nestled in the heart of Harbor Point. Boasting breathtaking waterfront views and impeccable modern design, this residence offers a lifestyle of comfort and sophistication. Ideally situated in Harbor Point, known for its vibrant community and scenic waterfront.Enjoy panoramic vistas of the harbor and city skyline from the expansive windows throughout the unit. Spacious and bright, featuring an open-concept layout that seamlessly connects the living, dining, and kitchen areas. Fully equipped with high-end appliances, sleek countertops, and ample storage space.Two generously sized bedrooms including a master suite with a luxurious ensuite bathroom and private balcony access. Elegant bathrooms with modern fixtures and finishes. Outdoor Space: Relax and entertain on your private balcony overlooking the water or take advantage of the community's landscaped grounds.Access to a sparkling pool, secure underground parking for residents. Truly a thriving neighborhood with trendy cafes, restaurants, and shops just steps away from 98 Southfield Ave!
